note: Election of county councillors for the County of Londonderry, polled Friday 2 June 1933 (Londonderry Sentinel, 3 June 1933, p. 6: 'Polling took [place] yesterday in the Bellarena division of County Derry'). Bellarena was the only one of the nineteen divisions contested; the count was held at the Courthouse, Bishop Street, Derry, on Saturday morning, 3 June, and the result was printed in the Sentinel of 6 June and the Derry Journal of 5 June. The eighteen members returned unopposed are named in the Derry Journal's nominations report of 1 May 1933. The retiring Unionist defeated an unofficial Unionist by 98 votes.
